explanation: Q1 and Q2 are not equivalent. Q1 checks if a drinker has not frequented any bar that serves a beer which the drinker does not like. Q2, on the other hand, checks if a drinker has frequented the same number of bars that serve beers the drinker likes as the total number of beers the drinker likes.
